translation: kuma ku koya musu ⟨su kasance⟩ ⟨את⟩ ɗukanku, don ku faɗa da su — a lokacin da kuke zaune a cikin gidanku, kuma a lokacin da kuke tafiya a hanya, kuma a lokacin da kuke kwance, kuma a lokacin da kake tashi.

tokens.gloss: kuma a lokacin da kuke tafiya
kuma a lokacin da kuke kwance
kuma a lokacin da kake tashi
